record.title: Catalogger snapshot ingest publishes to the Page when calendar_auto_approve is on
record.description: HTTP preview, publish, Approve, and Post now call require_facebook_poster and publish_posts refuses confirm=false. force does not drop those gates. A parallel path does: if the owner has set facebook_calendar_auto_approve, sync_facebook_calendar_after_snapshot selects the first owner user and calls publish_posts or the in-memory poster thread with confirm=True. POST /integrations/engagement/snapshots is available to any authenticated staff JWT (owner or catalogger; clients are blocked by enforce_client_http) and always runs that sync, so a catalogger can submit snapshot metrics that score as Push and cause Page schedule/publish without the owner confirm click. PATCH /integrations/facebook/settings is owner-only but also syncs every engagement sale as soon as the flag is enabled.
record.claimed_root_cause: calendar_auto_approve hard-codes confirm=True as a synthetic owner and is triggered by catalogger-reachable snapshot ingest, bypassing require_facebook_poster on the publish routes.

trace.description: Any authenticated staff user can POST a watcher snapshot; there is no owner gate.
After commit, every snapshot calls sync_facebook_calendar_after_snapshot.
When facebook_calendar_auto_approve is true, the first owner is loaded and pending slots are published with confirm=True.
create_page_feed_post runs under the synthetic owner without a new HTTP confirm from that owner.

evidence.description: can_manage_integrations is owner-only; that is the HTTP Facebook poster gate.
publish_posts returns 400 unless confirm is true.
Auto-approve passes confirm=True into the background poster.
Enabling the setting immediately syncs every engagement sale.
The background runner does not call require_facebook_poster before publish_posts.
Turning calendar_auto_approve on causes Graph feed calls without a per-slot confirm body.

blockers: No OS-enforced sandbox, so the catalogger-snapshot plus auto-approve path was not executed.
Whether the deployed watcher/extension uses a catalogger token for POST /integrations/engagement/snapshots is not source-provable.

validation_plan.local: Using the existing TestClient fixtures, connect a Page, keep an owner User row, set calendar_auto_approve as owner, then authenticate as a catalogger and POST /integrations/engagement/snapshots for a future Push lot with Graph feed mocked. Expect create_page_feed_post to run and a scheduled FacebookPagePost row to appear. Repeat with the flag false and expect no feed call.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner confirms which staff role the live watcher ingest uses and whether auto-approve is enabled on production accounts.
